```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# load in packages and files
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)

# load in datasets
demo_data <- read_excel("demo-data.xlsx", sheet = "Time 1")
eng_results <- read_excel("english-results-data.xlsx", sheet = "Time 1")

# 1. Clean column names and select core WAB assessment metrics
eng_clean <- eng_results %>%
  rename(
    wab_aq         = `WAB         AQ\r\nNote: for Baycrest and NEURAL corpora, WAB scores are from Bedside WAB`,
    wab_type       = `WAB Type`,
    fluency_score  = `WAB SpontSp Fluency`,
    comp_score     = `AudVbl Comp Score for AQ`,
    rep_score      = `Rep Score for AQ`,
    naming_score   = `Naming Score for AQ`
  ) %>%
  # Ensure numeric type
  mutate(wab_aq = as.numeric(wab_aq)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(wab_aq))

# 2. Merge with cleaned demographics data
demo_results_merged <- demo_clean %>%
  inner_join(eng_clean, by = "Participant ID")



# VIZ 3: Overall Aphasia Severity (WAB AQ) by Boston Aphasia Subtype

ggplot(demo_results_merged, aes(x = reorder(aphasia_type, wab_aq, FUN = median, na.rm = TRUE), 
                                 y = wab_aq, 
                                 fill = aphasia_type)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set3") +
  labs(
    title = "Western Aphasia Battery (WAB AQ) Severity by Aphasia Subtype",
    subtitle = paste0("N = ", nrow(demo_results_merged), " participants; lower scores indicate higher severity"),
    x = "Aphasia Type (Boston Classification)",
    y = "WAB Aphasia Quotient (AQ)",
    fill = "Aphasia Type"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
# VIZ 4: Domain Performance Profile across Subtypes

demo_results_long <- demo_results_merged %>%
  mutate(aphasia_type = fct_reorder(aphasia_type, wab_aq, .fun = median, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  select(aphasia_type, fluency_score, comp_score, naming_score) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(fluency_score, comp_score, naming_score),
    names_to = "Domain",
    values_to = "Score"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Domain = case_when(
      Domain == "fluency_score" ~ "Fluency",
      Domain == "comp_score" ~ "Auditory Comprehension",
      Domain == "naming_score" ~ "Naming",
      TRUE ~ Domain
    ),
    Score = as.numeric(Score)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Score))

ggplot(demo_results_long, aes(x = aphasia_type, y = Score, fill = Domain)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ Domain, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(
    title = "WAB Domain Scores across Clinical Aphasia Subtypes",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Subtest Score"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
```

```{r}


# any significant comorbidities -->> Apraxia of Speech, Dysarthria, Depression
# years of SLP (speech language pathology) treatment -->> Years SLP Tx
# how recent the strokes were -->> Date of Most Recent Stroke, Hx Previous Stroke, Date of Previous Stroke
# lesioning -->> Lesion Side, Lesion Etiology, Lesion Location, Lesion Location Basis, Lesion Description



demo_clean <- demo_data %>%
  rename(
    aphasia_type   = `Aphasia Type --Clin Impression -- Boston`,
    aphasia_cat    = `Aphasia Category -- Clin Impression`,
    lesion_side    = `Lesion Side`,
    lesion_loc_raw = `Lesion Location`
  ) %>%
  # Filter out missing/uninformative values upfront
  filter(!is.na(lesion_loc_raw), 
         !lesion_loc_raw %in% c("U", "NA", "unavailable", "not applicable", "")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(aphasia_type), 
         !aphasia_type %in% c("U", "NA", "unavailable", "not applicable", "non-classifiable")) %>%
  
  # Expanded anatomical RegEx parser
  mutate(
    lesion_loc_clean = case_when(
      str_detect(tolower(lesion_loc_raw), "front|fomtal|frnt") ~ "Frontal",
      str_detect(tolower(lesion_loc_raw), "temp|tmpr") ~ "Temporal",
      str_detect(tolower(lesion_loc_raw), "pariet|prtl") ~ "Parietal",
      str_detect(tolower(lesion_loc_raw), "occip") ~ "Occipital",
      str_detect(tolower(lesion_loc_raw), "subcort|basal|thalam|capsul|bg|ic") ~ "Subcortical",
      str_detect(tolower(lesion_loc_raw), "mca") ~ "MCA Territory (Unspecified)",
      TRUE ~ "Other / Missing Detail"
    )
  )

```



```{r}
# Clean and filtered dataset for Left Hemisphere strokes
demo_L_hemisphere <- demo_clean %>%
  filter(lesion_side %in% c("L", "left"))

ggplot(demo_L_hemisphere, aes(x = aphasia_type, fill = lesion_loc_clean)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(
    title = "Lesion Location by Aphasia Type (Left Hemisphere Strokes)",
    subtitle = paste0("N = ", nrow(demo_L_hemisphere), " participants with available lesion details"),
    x = "Aphasia Type (Boston Classification)",
    y = "Number of Participants",
    fill = "Lesion Site"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```
